description: This is a React-like component defined using LightningJS, representing a Recipe Card UI component with properties, computed values, input handlers, and focus/unfocus behavior.

classes.name: RecipeCard
classes.description: A LightningJS component displaying recipe details with hover effects and navigation.

methods.name: textMuted
methods.description: Returns muted text color from theme.

methods.name: radiusLg
methods.description: Returns large radius value from theme.

methods.name: radiusLgOutline

methods.name: alphaValue
methods.description: Alpha value based on hover state.

methods.name: hoverAlpha
methods.description: Alpha for hover overlay based on hover state.

methods.name: imageSrc
methods.description: Returns the image source URL from item or placeholder.

methods.name: titleText
methods.description: Returns the title text from item.

methods.name: desc
methods.description: Returns a truncated description from item.
